Pistol Combat Styles

Choose Pistol for shots that reward changing targets or disrupt opponents.

Pistol - Gambler

Gambler rewards switching targets with a critical chance; critical hits can also restore Stamina.

Pistol - Skirmisher

Skirmisher favors disrupting one target with shots that can disarm or interrupt.
